background: When an organization provides a retirement plan for its employees, these benefits can become
a commitment that members of the schemes plan on for their long-term economic well-being.
Defined benefit plans have potential implications for employers in terms of the obligations that
need to be met. Other types of plans, such as defined contribution plans, do not guarantee
access to a retirement plan or the quality of the benefits. Thus, the type of plan chosen has
implications for both employees and employers. Conversely, a properly funded pension plan
can help to attract and maintain employees and support long-term financial and strategic
planning on the part of the employer.
